title: Rohingya in Bangladesh welcome UN court’s genocide verdict but say they want to go home to Myanmar
paragraphs: Rohingya in Bangladesh welcome UN court’s genocide verdict but say they want to go home to Myanmar
It was a landmark judgment, finding Myanmar responsible for the crime against the country’s ethnic Rohingya - the first time the court ruled that a state committed genocide.

COX’S BAZAR, Bangladesh: Hundreds of Rohingya refugees in Bangladesh sat in front of a big screen at their sprawling camp in Cox’s Bazar, watching the news from the Netherlands, where the UN's top court ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya minority in a brutal 2017 military operation.
